This entry adds a menu entry, a tray entry, a settings page and a Dolphin action for PDFs. Certificates, token drivers and PINs stay in the program's own window.
codesys4_note: A web-based IEC 61131-3 development environment for industrial controllers and automation. CODESYS lists it for Windows x64, Linux x64 and Linux ARM64 (the Linux downloads are .deb files), and you use it in a web browser.

phonecamera_note: Use a phone's camera as this computer's camera. DroidCam: install the DroidCam app on the phone from its own store (the app is Dev47Apps' own), then connect by Wi-Fi or USB. scrcpy, the fully open way: no app on the phone, only USB debugging, Android 12 or newer; scrcpy's package fetches the small server it runs on the phone from the project's release page and checks its SHA-256. The phone shows up as the camera "Phone camera" in your programs and in System Settings, Camera. KDE Connect is not needed.
spirula_note: Create a 3D model from your photos or video. Optional processing profiles show their size and licence before installation. Purge also deletes downloaded profiles.
midi_gm_font: Additional MIDI soundfont. Choose it with: sparky-stereo-audio midi --font /PATH
midi_opl3_font: OPL3-style SoundFont for a sample synthesizer. It does not emulate an FM chip.
midi_mt32: Use your own MT-32 control and PCM ROMs in Munt’s ROM settings. No ROMs are supplied or downloaded.
midi_fm_bank: FM synthesis library for compatible programs. Supply your own WOPL or WOPN instrument bank; no banks are included.
midi_dosbox: DOS emulator independent of the original DOSBox project. General MIDI uses the installed default SoundFont. MT-32 needs your own control and PCM ROMs.

sensecom_note: SenseGlove's own program for finding and connecting their haptic gloves, downloaded from SenseGlove's address exactly as they publish it. With no glove connected its list is empty. Its own window is in English. The maker's Linux notes say it is not yet compatible with Nova gloves.
sensecom_comment: Finds and connects SenseGlove haptic gloves
